grammar.pattern: 对 + 对象 + 态度 / 评价
grammar.purpose: Specify the target of an attitude
grammar.explanation: 对朋友友好 describes how someone treats friends. 对这个安排满意 identifies the arrangement being evaluated. Keep the target explicit; a comment on an arrangement is not a judgement about the whole person. 对 is a preposition here; 对 meaning correct was taught earlier.

examples.py: tā duì péng you hěn rè qíng .
examples.en: She is welcoming to her friends.

examples.py: wǒ duì zhè gè ān pái mǎn yì .
examples.en: I am satisfied with this arrangement.

examples.zh: 对这个问题，我想先听你的意见。
examples.py: duì zhè gè wèn tí , wǒ xiǎng xiān tīng nǐ de yì jiàn .
examples.en: On this question, I would first like to hear your view.

commonMistakes.why: Put 对 and its target before the evaluation.

grammar.pattern: A 跟 B 一样 / 相同；A 跟 B 一样 + 形容词
grammar.explanation: 她跟姐姐一样安静 compares quietness, not every feature of the two people. 我们的想法相同 compares the stated idea. 她像姐姐 gives resemblance and may be less exact. Avoid using 一样 as evidence for unmentioned private facts. Name the quality or topic being compared.

examples.py: tā gēn jiě jie yī yàng ān jìng .
examples.en: She is as quiet as her elder sister.

examples.zh: 我们的想法相同，都想先问她。
examples.py: wǒ men de xiǎng fǎ xiāng tóng , dōu xiǎng xiān wèn tā .
examples.en: We have the same idea: first ask her.

examples.py: tā gēn wǒ yī yàng xǐ huān dú shū .
examples.en: He likes reading just as I do.

commonMistakes.why: In this predicate pattern 一样 directly precedes the adjective.

dialogue.title: One shared quality
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find what is alike and what remains unknown.

lines.zh: 她跟姐姐一样安静吗？
lines.py: tā gēn jiě jie yī yàng ān jìng ma ?
lines.en: Is she as quiet as her elder sister?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 平时是，但唱歌时不一样，很有力量。
lines.py: píng shí shì , dàn chàng gē shí bù yī yàng , hěn yǒu lì liàng .
lines.en: In everyday life, yes; when singing, she is different and powerful.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那她们的想法也完全相同吗？
lines.py: nà tā men de xiǎng fǎ yě wán quán xiāng tóng ma ?
lines.en: Then are their ideas completely identical too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不知道。安静只是一个特点，不是所有的想法。
lines.py: bù zhī dào . ān jìng zhǐ shì yī gè tè diǎn , bù shì suǒ yǒu de xiǎng fǎ .
lines.en: We do not know. Quietness is one characteristic, not every idea.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你对她的态度怎么样？
lines.py: nǐ duì tā de tài dù zěn me yàng ?
lines.en: How do you treat her?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我关心她，也尊重她想不想回答。
lines.py: wǒ guān xīn tā , yě zūn zhòng tā xiǎng bù xiǎng huí dá .
lines.en: I care about her and respect whether she wishes to answer.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 她很实在，答应的事认真做。
lines.py: tā hěn shí zai , dā yìng de shì rèn zhēn zuò .
lines.en: She is unpretentious and takes promises seriously.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那咱们先问她想参加什么，别替她选择。
lines.py: nà zán men xiān wèn tā xiǎng cān jiā shén me , bié tì tā xuǎn zé .
lines.en: Then let us first ask what she wants to join and not choose for her.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A considerate introduction
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read to separate observations from assumptions.

lines.zh: 她平时安静，跟姐姐一样喜欢读书。
lines.py: tā píng shí ān jìng , gēn jiě jie yī yàng xǐ huān dú shū .
lines.en: She is quiet in everyday life and likes reading as her sister does.

lines.zh: 唱歌时她很快乐，声音有力量。
lines.py: chàng gē shí tā hěn kuài lè , shēng yīn yǒu lì liàng .
lines.en: When singing she is happy and her voice is powerful.

lines.zh: 我们对生活的看法不完全相同。
lines.py: wǒ men duì shēng huó de kàn fǎ bù wán quán xiāng tóng .
lines.en: Our views on life are not completely the same.

lines.zh: 朋友之间平等，不能只让一个人选择。
lines.py: péng you zhī jiān píng děng , bù néng zhǐ ràng yī gè rén xuǎn zé .
lines.en: Friends relate as equals; one person should not make all the choices.

lines.zh: 今天的活动很一般，青少年和大人都可以来。
lines.py: jīn tiān de huó dòng hěn yì bān , qīng shào nián hé dà rén dōu kě yǐ lái .
lines.en: Today’s activity is ordinary; both young people and adults may come.

lines.zh: 她可以自由选择参加，也可以不参加。
lines.py: tā kě yǐ zì yóu xuǎn zé cān jiā , yě kě yǐ bù cān jiā .
lines.en: She may freely choose to participate or not.

lines.zh: 太阳出来，身边坐着朋友，日子很舒服。
lines.py: tài yáng chū lái , shēn biān zuò zhe péng you , rì zi hěn shū fu .
lines.en: The sun has come out, friends are sitting nearby, and life feels comfortable.

lines.zh: 永远保持关心，不是永远问隐私。
lines.py: yǒng yuǎn bǎo chí guān xīn , bù shì yǒng yuǎn wèn yǐn sī .
lines.en: Keep caring always; that does not mean always asking private questions.

lines.zh: 朋友之间【平等】，不能只让一个人选择。
lines.py: péng you zhī jiān píng děng , bù néng zhǐ ràng yī gè rén xuǎn zé .
lines.en: Friends relate as equals; one person should not make all the choices.

lines.zh: 她可以【自由】选择参加，也可以不参加。
lines.py: tā kě yǐ zì yóu xuǎn zé cān jiā , yě kě yǐ bù cān jiā .
lines.en: She may freely choose to participate or not.

lines.zh: 你像她，一样安静。
lines.py: nǐ xiàng tā , yī yàng ān jìng .

lines.zh: 像一点，不是全相同。

lines.py: xīn lǐ de lǐ xiǎng , wǒ xiǎng zì jǐ shuō .

lines.zh: 好，对朋友我先听。
lines.py: hǎo , duì péng you wǒ xiān tīng .

lines.zh: 今天不参加，可以吗？
lines.py: jīn tiān bù cān jiā , kě yǐ ma ?

lines.zh: 当然。自由选择，明天再聊。
lines.py: dāng rán . zì yóu xuǎn zé , míng tiān zài liáo .
lines.en: Of course. Choose freely; we can talk tomorrow.
